issue.title: fix: avoid false positive when module-level names match class-level names

repository.name: pylint
repository.description: It's not just a linter that annoys you!

issue.body:
## Description
Fixes a false positive  where module-level constants were incorrectly classified as variables when a class-level attribute with the same name exists. I added a scope check so now when we check for reassignments, we make sure we only look at nodes within the same scope

Closes #10719

body: Hey @RomanValov, i just raised a PR related to this issue. Hope it helps :)

issue.body:
What's new in Pylint 4.0.4?
--------------------------------
Release date: 2025-11-30


False Positives Fixed
---------------------

- Fixed false positive for ``invalid-name`` where module-level constants were incorrectly classified as variables when a class-level attribute with the same name exists.

  Closes #10719

- Fix a false positive for ``invalid-name`` on an UPPER_CASED name inside an ``if`` branch that assigns an object.

  Closes #10745
